errors.evidence: The description states that the blue line ('Äußere Sicherheit') falls to 93 in 2020. However, the chart shows that the line rises from approximately 95 in 2019 to approximately 100 in 2020.
The description claims the purple line ('Innere Sicherheit') falls to 98 in 2020. In the chart, this line actually rises from approximately 96 in 2019 to a value slightly above 100 in 2020.
The description states the green line ('Abwehr hybrider Gefahren') rises to 100 in 2020. According to the chart, the value in 2020 is visibly higher, at approximately 110.
